members.name: Andra Delanoye
members.bio_short: Host and co-founder of The Golden Crown.
members.bio_long: Host and co-founder of The Golden Crown with a deep passion for hospitality.
members.image_alt: Andra Delanoye, Co-Founder and Host of The Golden Crown

paragraphs: While we created The Golden Crown together, I now have the privilege of running the operations.
Welcoming guests here, seeing them relax, focus and connect in this environment is what makes all those years of effort worthwhile.
We look forward to sharing not just our property, but also the story and spirit behind it – with you.
